name: Lisbon
limitations: All8dimensions and31subpillars reviewed, not fully measured. ISR/TEC/OPT conditional60, MED conditional40; PCS/GSS/RES/LON unknown. Municipal/operator/institutional scopes and actual cohorts are not full-FUA or median-income measurements. Reversible cutoff/time/scope/representativeness/materiality assumptions; no missingness penalty, reliable exclusion bound or ranking.

dimensions.rationale: Municipal2025 spending supports seismic/tsunami and drainage work, but expenditure and tunnels still under construction do not demonstrate completed whole-area protection. Heat, weather exposure and resident outcomes remain unresolved.
dimensions.assumption: No whole-dimension anchor from a hazard model, expenditure or a future work programme. Keep adaptation and time applicability separate.

dimensions.rationale: No assigned historical or preliminary events do not establish low organised-violence impact. Local, regional and strategic consequences and mitigation remain insufficient for a whole-dimension anchor.
dimensions.assumption: No zero-risk inference from missing records, ordinary crime or national background.

dimensions.rationale: Actual emergency-generator/satellite response, field operations and post-power-restoration traffic recovery support execution, adaptation and crisis response. Welfare/emergency funding and accountability records support scoped services but not population-wide cohesion or independent outcomes.
dimensions.assumption: Accept scoped municipal/provider results as relevant to ordinary residents and FUA and continuing in2026; major institutions generally function while group and crisis limitations remain material. Undated reports require a pre-cutoff availability assumption. Reject necessary time/scope/adequacy assumptions to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: EPAL2025 water reserves maintained service for most customers during the blackout while local restrictions and actual annual interruptions persisted. Water-quality compliance indices are not household safety probabilities. Food, energy affordability and independent supply-chain substitution remain unresolved.
dimensions.assumption: No whole-dimension anchor from an operator summary, water result or one restored disruption. Keep wholesale/direct customers, events, delivery points, population and provider geography distinct.

dimensions.rationale: ERS2025H2 records actual completed first-consultation lateness at multiple local providers; ULSLO reports substantial waiting stocks and involuntary lack of assigned family doctors. Actual care, surgical timeliness, transfer vouchers and primary-care consultations mitigate but do not erase the observed access/continuity constraints. Unclosed mortality coding is not itself the low-score basis.
dimensions.assumption: Accept scoped cohorts as relevant to ordinary eligible median-income residents/FUA,2025-to-2026 continuity and timeliness constraints remaining material after observed mitigation. No cutoff waiting update or full risk-adjusted cohort demonstrated. Reject necessary representativeness, time or materiality assumptions to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: EMA human/regulatory evidence and a Luz Lisbon actual first-treatment statement are positive capabilities, but exact local product, payments, monitoring and ordinary eligible resident affordability are not connected. The payment tracker observed on11October cannot certify10October status; missing SNS access date does not rule out early/private access.
dimensions.assumption: No justified whole-dimension anchor. Do not inherit Paris/Seoul40 or default60 from approval, marketing, missing records or unlinked actual therapy.

dimensions.rationale: IST actual scientific output and contracted-research receipts, municipal network samples and real digital parking/shop use support production, industrial connection and adoption. Research-contract receipts fell, ongoing metering faults and narrowly surveyed senior service barriers coexist with alternative channels, published assistance and completed trainer preparation. Seven licensing contracts were in negotiation, not executed licences.
dimensions.assumption: Accept scoped institutional results, limited industry connection and service use as relevant, pre-cutoff available and continuing; reported innovation/skill constraints remain material after actual mitigation and reasonably apply to ordinary residents/FUA. One narrow survey is not population prevalence. Unknown wider capability does not cap the score; reject necessary time/scope/materiality assumptions to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Actual Lisbon airport traffic, road/metro/bus access and bank SEPA channels plus EU-citizen conditional German residence rules support multiple ordinary channels. Actual mobile/fixed/internet failure contrasts with municipal emergency satellite/generator operation; emergency continuity is not universal resident fallback.
dimensions.assumption: Accept normal operations persist, undated current source conditions were pre-cutoff available and ordinary citizens can qualify for and afford transport/accounts/communications. Legal rights retain purpose/resources conditions; no independent crisis redundancy established. Reject necessary availability, time, cost or scope assumptions to restore unknown.
